# SpendSathi

> SpendSathi is a privacy-first Android expense tracker and budget manager built for Indian users. It automatically parses bank, credit card, and UPI SMS alerts entirely on-device—never uploading financial or SMS data to any server.

## Product Overview
- **Target Audience:** Android users in India tracking UPI, bank account, and credit card spending
- **Platform:** Android (Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.finmate.app)
- **Pricing:** Free Forever (`₹0`, ad-supported) with an optional one-time Ad-Free / Pro upgrade in INR (no recurring subscription)
- **Privacy Architecture:** 100% on-device local Room/SQLite storage; zero cloud sync, zero bank login credentials required, zero SMS data sent to external servers

## Core Features
- **Automatic Bank & UPI SMS Parsing:** Reads debit, credit, UPI, and card alerts locally on Android across major Indian banks (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Yes Bank, etc.) and UPI apps.
- **Spend Score & Safe Daily Spend:** Real-time financial health score (0–100) and daily spending allowance based on remaining monthly budget and days left in the month.
- **Investment Separation:** Automatically separates SIPs, Mutual Funds, and Investments from everyday living expenses so dashboards and budgets stay accurate.
- **Monthly Budgets & Visual Analytics:** Category donut charts, daily/monthly spending trend bars, and weekly outflow tracking.
- **PDF Financial Statements:** Export clean, shareable monthly PDF expense reports directly from the phone.
